paragraphs: Schedule Express sells public safety scheduling software that handles staffing, overtime, absences, trades, and workforce visibility in one platform. The pitch is against spreadsheets, disconnected tools, and constant follow-up, with a scheduling process meant to support both leadership and staff. Capabilities listed on the solutions page cover schedule management that enforces policies, CBAs, and MOUs, automated overtime intelligence, coverage plans, shift and vacation bidding, and payroll and time bank tracking.

The environments served are grouped as 911, Law, Jail, Fire, and EMS, alongside operations such as power, water, and transportation. For law enforcement the listed features include beat and sector assignments, fatigue management rules, and off-duty details. Customers named in testimonials include City of Houston, Texas, County of Santa Clara, California, and Montgomery County, Pennsylvania.

Buyers can purchase directly from the company, or through the Texas Department of Information Resources contract. A third route is the California Department of General Services Software Licensing Program.

quote.text: Built to meet the needs of 911, Schedule Express delivers.
